notes.title: New Exciting Content Update!
notes.notes:
We've added some fun new stuff for you to play around with. We have a new story mission, a survival map and a freeze gun amongst many other things. Christmas might be over, but that does not mean you can't still have some snowy adventures! jump in an blow stuff up.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24749592/da84397ebf33f31ec6769136bcf09687aaec3cd6.gif[/img]

Below is a list of all the new content, as well as some fixes and changes that we've tinkered on. Enjoy! 

[h1]2017-03-03  v 1.0.4.12:292 [Stable][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added new Level “ChristmasTown”
    [*]Added new Level “Plothole”
    [*]Added Tracks Between levels
    [*]Added new unlockable weapons FreezeGun
    [*]Added new unlockable upgrades for the player

    [*]Changed mission briefing for “Grand Crayon”
    [*]Changed damage radius of rockets
    [*]Changed how rocketeers move
    [*]Fixed leaderboards not being uploaded correctly
    [*]Fixed npc not ragdolling	

[/list]

Warm wintery hugs!
/The Guru Games development team

notes.title: Optimization and bugfix update
notes.notes:
Not the most exciting of news perhaps, but important none the less. We’ve seen some requests for better performance, and if you ask for something we try to deliver. It is our hope that your framerate will be as smooth as our wordpuns.

Besides focusing on improving performance and squashing bugs we are cooking up some really cool stuff, but it will have to wait a little longer. 


With the next update we will introduce a really cool new level that fleshes out the campaign a bit more, and puts more meat on the bones of our storyline. So stay tuned and have an awesome day! 

- The Guru Games team

notes.title: A mish mash picknick update of goodies, also wiping away more of those annoying little bugs!
notes.notes:
This week we have arrived at version 0.8 with a lot of bugfixing, balance changes making it a bit harder, as well as some first drafts of comic book styled cutscenes for the Story-mode!(so far there´s no text in the strips, our designer was hijacked to a castle game jam) On another note the computers been behaving themselves after last weeks “summer break” and change of harddrives, so now we are up to speed again!

With the changes in the game’s balance we have reset all leaderboards to make it more fair for everyone.

[h1]Below you can see what just went up [/h1]

[h1]2016-07-08  v 0.8.0.11:166 [Stable][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added Unlockable Upgrade Cards through completing campaign levels
    [*]Added cutscene “Rosa Gone” to “The Farm”
    [*]Added cutscene “Near the End” to “Last Vulture”
    [*]Added Foundations to buildings missing it.
    [*]Added a separate survival version of “Last Vulture” 
    

    [*]Changed increased droprate for health pots in champaign
    [*]Changed Spawning rules in “Football Stadium” 
    [*]Changed generall spawning rules for survival maps.


    [*]Fixed enemy card “Personal Shield” spawning a tank in a tank
    [*]Fixed Leaderboard getting stuck in a loading and not updating itself
    [*]Fixed Leaderboard not submitting data automatically
    [*]Fixed Leaderboard type name stretching over the edge.
    [*]Fixed Leaderboard showing template boxes
    [*]Fixed Level names shown in Leaderboards
    [*]Fixed input being read while the game is paused
    [*]Fixed Destruction on buildings missing them.
    [*]Fixed drops spawning on destroyed instead of on death
    [*]Fixed enemies not spawning on higher elevation

    [*]Moved v 0.7.6.7:157 to Stable
    [*]Moved v 0.7.5.2:145 to Stable
[/list]

notes.title: Update # 2 is out!!!
notes.notes:
We have a new update for the game out now!!

The updated is uploaded to the Unstable branch.
    -  go to Properties
    -  go to Betas
    -  Select unstable in the dropdown window.

[h1]2016-06-24  v 0.7.5.2:145 -unstable[/h1]
[list]
    [*]New survival map “Football stadium”
    [*]New enemy “Double barrel tank”
    [*]Attack animation for bazooka segway
    [*]Added player damage feedback
    [*]Fixed Popup placement 
    [*]Added Support for easier implementation of more weapons
    [*]Added 5 new upgrade cards for the enemies
    [*]Made it harder to jump over level edges
[/list]
